in_marathi.name: Chouhanika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chouhanika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chouhanika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chouhana', which means 'God of Victory'. This name is given to a girl, signifying her victory in all aspects of life. It is believed that the goddess of victory, Durga, protects and guides the bearer of this name.
